label: Catholic Church, Catechism of the Catholic…: CCC 185-189: whoever says 'I believe' says 'I pledge…
locator: CCC 185-189, Communion in faith needs a common language of faith, normative for all
interpretation: CCC 185: 'Communion in faith needs a common language of faith, normative for all and uniting all in the same confession of faith'; CCC 187: 'professions of faith' 'since they summarize the faith that Christians profess'; CCC 189: 'The first "profession of faith" is made during Baptism.' It describes the creed's role and who professes it, not how believers understand their profession.
attribution: The passage states that communion in faith needs a common language of faith normative for all, that the creeds summarize the faith Christians profess, and that the first profession is made at Baptism, which is the premise.
